Exposes Zotero Find Full Text, attachment rename, and local file import over the local HTTP server for the zot CLI.

checkNote: The plugin only exposes Find Full Text, rename and file import over Zotero's local HTTP server (manifest description). Its code calls no services and keeps no key. The Zotero Web API key belongs to the separate zot CLI, and a Zotero sign-in doesn't count anyway. The plugin has no AI features.
